sources.title: LLaMA - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is used to instantiate an LLaMA model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the LLaMA-7B. Configuration objects inherit from PretrainedConfig and can be used to control the model outputs.
